scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,dash -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @freellmapi/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/dashboard
scripts.setup: npm run build -w @freellmapi/shared && DATABASE_URL=file:./apps/api/dev.db npx prisma db push --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma --skip-generate
